description: Convert latitude/longitude coordinates to the nearest US street address. Returns the address with county, ZIP+4 and time zone, the distance in meters from the input point, an accuracy type, and a confidence score. Set limit (2 to 10) to also get other addresses near the point in nearby, one per building, nearest first. Use when you have coordinates and need the closest address. US coverage only. To go the other way (address to coordinates) use sthan_geocode. Read-only with no side effects. Requires a sthan.io API key in STHAN_API_KEY; each call counts toward your plan's rate limit (a free tier is available). On failure it returns an error message.

limit.description: Addresses to return, 1 to 10 (default 1). Above 1, other nearby addresses come back in nearby

name: sthan_reverse_geocode
title: Reverse Geocode Coordinates
